'''Haikouichthys''' is an [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] [[vermin]] from the [[wikipedia:Cambrian|Cambrian]] era, found in [[tropical]] oceans or saltwater [[pool]]s. They are not fishable, and too small to butcher.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] haikouichthys for their ''extra eyes'' and ''fins''.
